parameters.name: truck_types
parameters.description: Set of truck types, indexed by t=0,\dots,|\mathcal{T}|-1

parameters.name: cargo_classes
parameters.description: Set of cargo classes, indexed by k=0,\dots,|\mathcal{K}|-1

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Single-period planning horizon containing one rental planning period

parameters.name: demand
parameters.description: Required demand for each cargo class k

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Capacity of truck type t for cargo class k

parameters.name: rental_cost_rate
parameters.description: Per-kilometer rental cost rate for each truck type t

variables.name: truck_count
variables.description: Nonnegative integer number of trucks of each type t to rent

variables.name: total_cost
variables.description: Minimized total rental cost, expressed per kilometer unless a travel distance parameter is provided

constraints.name: truck_count_integrality
constraints.description: Truck counts are nonnegative integers, so only whole trucks may be rented.

constraints.name: cargo_demand_coverage
constraints.description: For each cargo class k, the total capacity provided by all rented trucks must meet or exceed the required demand d_k.

constraints.name: single_period_horizon_structural_assumption
constraints.description: The planning horizon contains exactly one rental period; this is a structural property of the instance rather than an optimization restriction.

objectives.name: total_rental_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total rental cost while ensuring all cargo class demands are covered simultaneously.

final_objective.description: Minimize the total per-kilometer rental cost of the rented truck fleet. Since no travel distance parameter is provided, the objective remains the linear per-kilometer total cost \(\sum_{t\in\mathcal{T}} c_t x_t\).
